# Project Docs Template

Copy this structure into each micro-project.

```text
docs/
  project-brief.md
  implementation-log.md
  decisions.md
  validation-notes.md
  next-steps.md
  cabinet-summary.md
```

## `project-brief.md`

```md
# Project Brief

## One-liner

## Hypothesis

## Target user

## Smallest useful POC

## What exists now

## Out of scope
```

## `implementation-log.md`

```md
# Implementation Log

## Latest changes

- TODO

## Important files

- TODO

## How to run

## Known issues
```

## `decisions.md`

```md
# Decisions

## Decision: <title>

Date:

Context:

Decision:

Reason:

Impact:
```

## `validation-notes.md`

```md
# Validation Notes

## How to validate

## What to check on MacBook

## Success criteria

## Concerns
```
